note: The list of the example pages, in groups. examples/index.js shows it, examples/frame.js makes the frame of each page from it, and the browser check follows each path. needs is the command of the fixture API that an example needs. components gives each component of the page, and the docs panel shows the docs of each one.

examples.name: Loans
examples.text: A card, an action button, a card grid with collapse controls and a form.

examples.name: Primitives
examples.text: Each primitive: text, a button, the fields, a stack and a grid.

examples.name: Approvals
examples.text: Open decisions as cards with their evidence. A person approves or rejects each decision.

examples.name: Approval icons
examples.text: A request card with icon buttons to approve or reject the request.

examples.name: Application contract
examples.text: An application registers its own contract and element for a seed tray, and an agent fills it.

examples.name: Offline source
examples.text: An offline data source of a tool library in each state, offline and online.

examples.name: Offline queue
examples.text: A person reserves a tool offline. The action waits as pending, and it goes through after the device reconnects.

examples.name: Status
examples.text: Each state of the status component, and a refused state.

examples.name: Input types
examples.text: A form with text, long text, a number, a date and a choice, with typed edits of the number and the date.

examples.name: Library notices
examples.text: A library notice form with two switches.

examples.name: Loan and price settings
examples.text: A form with one slider for the loan period and two sliders for a synthetic price range.

examples.name: Library pickup branch
examples.text: Choose a pickup branch from 40 synthetic library branches.

examples.name: Garden bed
examples.text: Choose the sun levels and plants for a garden bed.

examples.name: Room booking
examples.text: Set the booking dates, the start time and the setup date and time.

examples.name: Membership form
examples.text: A form card with 3 sections and 25 fields in a thread. A person edits one field in place.

examples.name: Upload
examples.text: An upload control with the limits of the page. Each file shows Done only after its receipt.

examples.name: Table
examples.text: A table of plots with keyboard sorting, row status text and an empty table.

examples.name: Data grid
examples.text: An editable grid with a budget, typed cells and a total row that the page computes.

examples.name: Density presets
examples.text: A card grid and a data grid in the default and compact densities.

examples.name: Review queue
examples.text: A reviewer accepts, corrects or rejects an extracted value next to its source excerpt, on a fixture API.

examples.name: Snapshots
examples.text: A comparison of two snapshots of versioned records with a diff, on a fixture API.

examples.name: Citation
examples.text: A citation in a message, a citation with no source and a refused citation.

examples.name: Excerpt
examples.text: An excerpt of a document with a marked span in a message, and a refused excerpt.

examples.name: Provenance slots
examples.text: A card with the authorship slot and the citation slot, and a refused card.

examples.name: Diff
examples.text: A diff of two versions of a hall booking, and a large diff that starts closed.

examples.name: Narration check
examples.text: A check that compares the narration of an agent with the values of a card.

examples.name: Thread
examples.text: Two people and two agents talk about a loan, with a refused component and an action with a receipt.

examples.name: Rich text
examples.text: An agent message with a heading, a list of steps and a link, as typed nodes.

examples.name: Image
examples.text: A floor plan from a permitted origin in a message and in a card, and a refused image.

examples.name: Charts
examples.text: A bar chart, a line chart and a stacked bar chart, each with a table view.

examples.name: Support desk
examples.text: A ticket queue and a thread. A person corrects the reply that an agent drafts, and sends it.

examples.name: Change review
examples.text: An agent proposes a timetable change with a citation. A reviewer approves it with a confirm step.

examples.name: Field inspection
examples.text: A registered checklist component, a findings form and a close action, for a phone.

examples.name: Contracts guide
examples.text: The page of the contracts guide: a valid fill, refused fills and an application contract.

examples.name: Assemble guide
examples.text: The assembly guide shows a thread, a card with an action and a form with a draft reply.

examples.name: Theme guide
examples.text: The page of the theme guide: the kit theme and a second theme.

examples.name: Component gallery
examples.text: Compare each catalog component in the three presets and in light and dark modes.
